newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Fuji arranges $250 mln FNB loan.
newsitem.headline: Fuji arranges $250 mln FNB loan.

text.p: First National Bank Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that Fuji Bank had arranged a $250 million term loan facility on its behalf.
FNB said in a statement that this loan replaced the general purpose $230 million one-year term loan successfully concluded in February 1996.

It said the new facility was successfully received in the market with over $270 million being committed to it. It was increased from the launch amount of $230 million with lenders being scaled back, FNB said.
A total of 47 banks representing all continents committed themselves to the transaction.

FNB said co-arrangers of the loan, which was signed on Tuesday, was the Development Bank of Singapore Ltd, Dresdner Bank Luxembourg SA, ING Barings and Midland Bank Plc. Henry Ansbacher acted as advisor to the borrower.
FNB said the facility would be drawn down in five tranches of $50 million between February and May this year. Each tranche would mature one year from date of drawdown.
It said interest would be LIBOR plus 0.285 percent per annum.
